newsitem.title: UK: IPE natural gas untraded again, few bids seen.
newsitem.headline: IPE natural gas untraded again, few bids seen.

text.p: The IPE natural gas futures market got off to a disappointing start on Wednesday morning, with no trade done in the two-hour session.

The lack of interest was demonstrated by the fact that seven of the 12 contract months were without bids by the close of the session. Where bids were seen, in the front four months and February, they were too far from offers for trade to look a realistic possibility. A spread of 0.975 pence a therm between bids and offers was posted in February.
IPE volumes have been thin recently, with only five lots done on Tuesday morning and only 20 in the whole day.
